text: Trusted sources: official websites, international organisations, certified experts. Teach him: "If it seems too incredible to believe, it is most likely false."

review_defects.arabic: لو كان مستحيل التصديق، غالباً كذب
review_defects.english: If it seems too incredible to believe, it is most likely false.
review_defects.why: The English adds 'seems', which is not in the Arabic. The Arabic is absolute ('If it is impossible to believe, it is often a lie'), while the English softens it by making it about appearance.
